// diagnostic

E0637

The `{` of this typed literal is read as the start of the body

What

The `{` of this typed literal is read as the start of the body

Why

In an `if` or `loop` header, `{` opens the body, so `a > I32{0}` reads as `a > I32` followed by the body `{0}`

Fix

Compare with a plain number, as in `if a > 0 ->`, or group the literal, as in `if a > (I32{0}) ->`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0637: tests/ui/loop_header_typed_literal.stderr.

Error [jet.TypedLiteralInHeader]: The `{` of this typed literal is read as the start of the body
  --> tests/ui/loop_header_typed_literal.jet:3:18
    |
  3 |     loop word in [String]{"x", "y"} -> print(word)
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
